subject.title: fix(ai): reject non-finite tool schema numbers

question: Should OpenClaw intentionally quarantine existing plugin tools that emit NaN or infinity, replacing the current silent null rewrite?
rationale: The patch is technically correct, but it deliberately makes an invalid schema that previously survived become unavailable after upgrade, so accepting that compatibility change requires maintainer ownership.

options.title: Accept strict JSON quarantine
options.body: Merge the PR so invalid non-finite schemas are rejected with an exact repair diagnostic instead of being silently altered.

options.title: Preserve compatibility temporarily
options.body: Keep the PR open and require a separately designed transition path, accepting continued schema corruption or additional compatibility complexity in the meantime.

recommendation.title: Accept strict JSON quarantine
recommendation.body: Merge the PR so invalid non-finite schemas are rejected with an exact repair diagnostic instead of being silently altered.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to the PR and authored the final exact-head diagnostic-path correction.
